name: anim_wani_idle
subject: a huge muscular crocodile monster made of thick pink and yellow marbled liquid paint, its lower body melting into a puddle, no legs
desc: Idle breathing loop: massive chest heaves slowly, shoulders flex, the gooey body wobbles and the puddle base ripples. Stays in place. Thick, sticky, viscous goo: paint sagging, stretching and dripping slowly.
